name: Teferi, Time Raveler
oracle_text:
Each opponent can cast spells only any time they could cast a sorcery.
+1: Until your next turn, you may cast sorcery spells as though they had flash.
−3: Return up to one target artifact, creature, or enchantment to its owner's hand. Draw a card.
blocked_sentences: Each opponent can cast spells only any time they could cast a sorcery.
+1: Until your next turn, you may cast sorcery spells as though they had flash.

needs.what: a player-wide static (affects_player: "opponent") restricting every spell those players cast to sorcery timing: only during their own main phase with an empty stack (307.1 timing), overriding flash and cast_as_though_flash
needs.why_existing_wont_do: cant_cast_spells is an outright prohibition and static_condition_keys has no phase or empty-stack test, so it cannot be conditioned to 'outside sorcery timing'; cast_as_though_flash points the other way

needs.what: a one-shot effect from a loyalty ability giving its controller permission to cast Sorcery spells as though they had flash, lasting until their next turn (cleared in their untap step), limited to sorcery spells only
needs.why_existing_wont_do: cast_as_though_flash exists only as a static and the loader refuses any 'affects' spell filter on it, so it cannot be narrowed to sorcery spells; no op grants it for a duration, and grant_ability durations have no until-your-next-turn for a granted static
